people.title: Stores & people

redemptions.title: Redemptions
redemptions.lead: Every reward request across your stores. GMs approve these in their app; you can step in here too.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.lead: What crew can spend their coins on, what each costs, and which tier or badge unlocks it.

coins.title: Coins & limits

spin.title: Spin the wheel
spin.lead: When crew earn a spin, how many they can get, and what's on the wheel. Spins are always earned, never bought.

badges.title: Badges & tiers

awards.title: Monthly awards
awards.lead: Award categories each store competes in, and the coins each winner gets. Winners are picked from the month's numbers.
